metadata.description: Data visualization that holds up: brainstorm it, build it, verify it.

plugins.name: vizardry
plugins.description: Observable-grade data visualizations as React components with D3. Ships /datastorm, which profiles a dataset and brainstorms options from conventional to abstract; /datastorm-parallel, which builds those option charts with concurrent verified agents; the routing rule and component contract as a skill; 212 self-contained exemplars with a retrieval index; a verifier that runs source rules, tsc and a jsdom render over what the model wrote; /data-docket, which grills a dataset owner into the honesty conditions a brainstorm cannot measure; /mandate-docket, which records who can actually act and what they hold the pen on; /redline, which turns a built report into policy changes routed to named seats; and /stormclips, which renders deterministic MP4 clips of the charts in a built report.
